items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 80:1
items.html: (To the question) This is understood from its source in Nekudim, where the root of the Nukva is at the time of the smallness of ZA, when she is only the aspect of a point below the chest, relative to the vessels, and a point below the Yesod, relative to the clothing of the lights. But at the time of the Gadlut of ZA of Nekudim, when he raised his AHAP from BYA, the Nukva was also built from them, in her upper nine. Therefore the separate Nukva does not exist at all from the beginning, but only after the Gadlut of the Neshama of ZA, when he also raises in Atzilut his new NHY from BYA, from which the Nukva takes her upper nine, as above. And likewise, at the time that ZA himself returns to VAK, and the new NHY are nullified from him, the aspect of the upper nine of the Nukva is concealed with them. (Item 94 and in the Inner Light, s.v. and this).
